_comment: Diagnostic layout: same displays as wall_layout.multigpu.json, but each display shows the OTHER row's half of the virtual viewport. wall_layout.multigpu.reversed.json only reorders the tile array -- every display keeps its own rect there -- so it cannot tell content apart from hardware. This one moves the content while leaving display-to-adapter alone, so whichever of the two the cost follows is the answer. Renders the wall upside down on purpose; it is for measurement, not for looking at.
